from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from step.runtime import SilentTrialConfig, TrialAlreadyRegisteredError, build_container

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        container.trials.shutdown()
        container.repository.close()


app = FastAPI(title="STEP API", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
_dashboard_page = Path(__file__).parent / "static" / "dashboard.html"


@app.get("/health")
def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}


class TrialRegistrationRequest(BaseModel):
    trial_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
    scan_cron: str = "0 2 * * *"
    scan_window: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: container.settings.scan_window)
    data_source: str = "mock"
    compute_adapter: str = "lsf"
    ancillary_adapter: str = "none"
    payloads_dir: str | None = None
    results_dir: str | None = None
    ancillary_dir: str | None = None
    model_name: str = "dummy_score"
    model_version: str = "v0"
    now_offset: str = "0d"
    payload_cleanup_window: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: container.settings.payload_cleanup_window)
    ingest_interval_minutes: int = Field(default=15, ge=1)
    ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes: int = Field(default=1440, ge=1)
    compute_config: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    ancillary_config: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@app.post("/silent-trials")
def register_silent_trial(request: TrialRegistrationRequest) -> dict[str, str]:
    payloads_dir, results_dir, ancillary_dir = _resolve_trial_artifact_dirs(
        request.trial_id,
        request.payloads_dir,
        request.results_dir,
        request.ancillary_dir,
    )
    cfg = SilentTrialConfig(
        trial_id=request.trial_id,
        scan_cron=request.scan_cron,
        scan_window=request.scan_window,
        data_source=request.data_source,
        compute_adapter=request.compute_adapter,
        ancillary_adapter=request.ancillary_adapter,
        payloads_dir=payloads_dir,
        results_dir=results_dir,
        ancillary_dir=ancillary_dir,
        model_name=request.model_name,
        model_version=request.model_version,
        now_offset=request.now_offset,
        payload_cleanup_window=request.payload_cleanup_window,
        ingest_interval_minutes=request.ingest_interval_minutes,
        ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes=request.ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes,
        compute_config=request.compute_config,
        ancillary_config=request.ancillary_config,
    )
    try:
        container.trials.register_trial(cfg)
    except TrialAlreadyRegisteredError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    return {"status": "registered", "trial_id": cfg.trial_id}


def _resolve_trial_artifact_dirs(
    trial_id: str,
    payloads_dir: str | None,
    results_dir: str | None,
    ancillary_dir: str | None,
) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    root = Path(container.settings.artifacts_root)
    default_payloads = str(root / trial_id / "payloads")
    default_results = str(root / trial_id / "results")
    default_ancillary = str(root / trial_id / "ancillary")
    return payloads_dir or default_payloads, results_dir or default_results, ancillary_dir or default_ancillary


@app.get("/silent-trials")
def list_silent_trials() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return dashboard.list_trial_records()


@app.delete("/silent-trials/{trial_id}")
def unregister_silent_trial(trial_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    try:
        container.trials.unregister_trial(trial_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    return {"status": "unregistered", "trial_id": trial_id}


@app.post("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/scan/run")
def run_scan_now(trial_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    try:
        return container.trials.get(trial_id).run_scan_now()
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc


@app.post("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/results/ingest")
def ingest_results(trial_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    try:
        count = container.trials.get(trial_id).ingest_results()
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    return {"ingested": count}


@app.post("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/ancillary/ingest")
def ingest_ancillary_data(trial_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:

    return {"ingested": count}


@app.post("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/runs/{run_id}/retry")
def retry_failed_run(trial_id: str, run_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    try:
        trial = container.trials.get(trial_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    try:
        retry = trial.retry_failed_run(run_id)

    except ValueError as exc:

    return {"status": "retried", "trial_id": trial_id, **retry}


@app.get("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/scheduler/jobs")
def list_scheduler_jobs(trial_id: str) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str | None]]]:
    try:
        trial = container.trials.get(trial_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    return {"jobs": trial.scheduler.list_jobs()}


@app.get("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/runs")
def list_runs(trial_id: str, limit: int = 50):
    try:
        container.trials.get(trial_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    return container.repository.get_runs_summary(trial_id=trial_id, limit=limit)


@app.get("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/results/by-case")
def list_results_by_case(trial_id: str, limit: int = 200):
    try:
        container.trials.get(trial_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc
    return container.repository.get_results_by_case(trial_id=trial_id, limit=limit)


@app.get("/silent-trials/{trial_id}/results/by-slide/{slide_id}")

@app.get("/dashboard", response_class=FileResponse)

@app.get("/api/dashboard/trials/{trial_id}")
def dashboard_trial_detail(trial_id: str, limit: int = 200, include_cases: bool = True):
    try:
        return dashboard.get_trial_detail_with_options(trial_id=trial_id, limit=limit, include_cases=include_cases)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown trial '{trial_id}'") from exc


def _parse_cursor_datetime(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip()
    if normalized.endswith("Z"):
        normalized = normalized[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid cursor_created_at timestamp") from exc


def _parse_date_filter(value: str | None, *, end_exclusive: bool = False) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip()
    if not normalized:
        return None

    try:
        if len(normalized) == 10:
            parsed_date = date.fromisoformat(normalized)
            at_midnight = datetime.combine(parsed_date, time.min)
            if end_exclusive:
                return at_midnight + timedelta(days=1)
            return at_midnight
        if normalized.endswith("Z"):
            normalized = normalized[:-1] + "+00:00"
        return datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid date filter. Use YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.") from exc


@app.get("/api/dashboard/trials/{trial_id}/runs")
def dashboard_trial_runs(
    trial_id: str,
    page_size: int = 50,
    cursor_created_at: str | None = None,
    cursor_run_id: str | None = None,
    case_id: str | None = None,
    slide_id: str | None = None,
    date_from: str | None = None,
    date_to: str | None = None,
):
    parsed_date_from = _parse_date_filter(date_from, end_exclusive=False)
    parsed_date_to = _parse_date_filter(date_to, end_exclusive=True)
    if parsed_date_from is not None and parsed_date_to is not None and parsed_date_from >= parsed_date_to:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from must be earlier than date_to")

    try:
        return dashboard.get_trial_runs_page(
            trial_id=trial_id,
            page_size=page_size,
            cursor_created_at=_parse_cursor_datetime(cursor_created_at),
            cursor_run_id=cursor_run_id,
            case_id=case_id.strip() if case_id else None,
            slide_id=slide_id.strip() if slide_id else None,
            date_from=parsed_date_from,
            date_to=parsed_date_to,

## README.md
```
# STEP (Silent Trial Engine for Pathology)

STEP is a modular research engine that:

1. Scans LIS data sources on a schedule for new pathology cases/slides.
2. Submits one inference job per slide to a compute adapter.
3. Ingests completed inference and ancillary data on separate schedules and stores run state/results in MongoDB.
4. Keeps an audit log of scan, submission, and ingestion events.
5. Supports multiple registered silent trials, each with its own orchestrator/scheduler configuration.

## Documentation

- API reference: [`docs/API.md`](docs/API.md)
- Adapter deep dive (data + compute): [`docs/ADAPTERS.md`](docs/ADAPTERS.md)
- Contracts (payload/result/ancillary JSON): [`docs/CONTRACTS.md`](docs/CONTRACTS.md)
- Architecture details and version history: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- Live OpenAPI/Swagger UI (when API is running): `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`
- ReDoc (when API is running): `http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc`

## Set Up Environment

Install dependencies with either `pip` or `conda`.

### Option A: `pip`

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Option B: `conda`

```bash
conda create -n step python=3.11 -y
conda activate step
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Quick Setup (Mock Data + Local Compute)

This path uses:

- `data_source=mock` (dummy data adapter)
- `compute_adapter=local` (local compute adapter)
- `ancillary_adapter=manual` (ingest post-hoc ancillary JSONs)
- `entrypoint=scripts/inference_launcher.template.sh` (inference launcher that calls `scripts/worker_dummy.py`)

1. Create your local env file:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

2. Confirm key environment settings in `.env`:

```dotenv
STEP_DATA_SOURCE=mock
STEP_COMPUTE_ADAPTER=local
STEP_INFERENCE_ENTRYPOINT=scripts/inference_launcher.template.sh
STEP_MODEL_NAME=dummy_score
STEP_MODEL_VERSION=v0
```

If you use the `pip`/venv path (not `conda`), edit `scripts/inference_launcher.template.sh` and replace the `conda run ...` line with:

```bash
python scripts/worker_dummy.py --payload "$PAYLOAD" --results-dir "$RESULTS_DIR"
```

Make sure the inference launcher script is executable:

```bash
chmod +x scripts/inference_launcher.template.sh
```

3. Choose a MongoDB mode:

- External Mongo (default): `STEP_MONGO_MODE=external` and set `STEP_MONGO_URI`.
- Compose-managed Mongo: `STEP_MONGO_MODE=compose`.
- Apptainer/Singularity-managed Mongo (HPC): `STEP_MONGO_MODE=apptainer` or `STEP_MONGO_MODE=singularity`.

For `compose` and `apptainer` modes, `start_step.sh` first checks whether `STEP_MONGO_URI` is already reachable and reuses that live MongoDB instead of trying to launch a second instance.

4. Start the API:

```bash
chmod +x ./start_step.sh
./start_step.sh --env-file .env --reload
```

Useful script options:

- `--env-file <path>` (default `.env`)
- `--host <host>` (default `127.0.0.1`)
- `--port <port>` (default `8000`)
- `--reload`
- `--mongo-mode <external|compose|apptainer|singularity|skip>`

5. Register a dummy trial:

```bash
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "trial_id": "trial-a",
    "scan_window": "1d",
    "data_source": "mock",
    "compute_adapter": "local",
    "ancillary_adapter": "manual",
    "model_name": "dummy_score",
    "model_version": "v0",
    "compute_config": {
      "entrypoint": "scripts/inference_launcher.template.sh",
      "max_concurrency": 4
    }
  }'
```

6. Trigger scan and ingestion manually:

```bash
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/scan/run
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/results/ingest
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/ancillary/ingest
# optional: retry one failed run by run_id
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/runs/<run_id>/retry
```

7. View runs and dashboard:

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/runs
curl "http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/results/by-case?limit=200"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials/trial-a/results/by-slide/slide-001?limit=50"
```

- Dashboard: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/dashboard`
- Dashboard trial view now supports per-slide result inspection (latest score summary and raw JSON payload).

## Dashboard

The dashboard provides a read-only operations view for silent trials:

- Trial list with aggregate counts (`runs`, `cases`, `slides`, `results`).
- Trial detail with recent runs and case/slide status.
- Separate `Runs` and `Cases & Slides` tabs, each with independent filtering/search state.
- Per-case accordion showing slide status/location and run counts.
- Result inspection in both tabs (`Runs` by run, `Cases & Slides` by latest slide result), loaded on demand.
- Runs table optimized for scale via pagination (`Load more`) instead of rendering all rows at once.
- Runs filters for `case_id`, `slide_id`, and `created_at` date range (`date_from`, `date_to`).
- Cases tab pagination + search by `case_id` and `slide_id`.

## General Usage

### Registering a Trial

`POST /silent-trials` accepts core scheduling + adapter configuration.

Common fields:

- `trial_id`
- `scan_cron`
- `scan_window`
- `data_source`
- `compute_adapter`
- `ancillary_adapter`
- `model_name`
- `model_version`
- `ingest_interval_minutes` (compute result ingestion cadence)
- `ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes` (ancillary ingestion cadence)
- `compute_config` (adapter-specific)
- `ancillary_config` (adapter-specific)

`data_source=sql_lis_example` is a reference implementation and requires site-specific customization before use.

Example:

```bash
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/silent-trials \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "trial_id": "thoracic-v1",
    "scan_cron": "*/30 * * * *",
    "scan_window": "2d",
    "data_source": "sql_lis_example",
    "compute_adapter": "slurm",
    "ancillary_adapter": "manual",
    "model_name": "adeno_detector",
    "model_version": "2026.03",
    "ingest_interval_minutes": 10,
    "compute_config": {
      "entrypoint": "scripts/inference_launcher.eagle.sh",
      "partition": "gpu",
      "account": "acc_comppath_500k",
      "dry_run": false
    }
  }'
```

For full adapter-specific behavior and extension points, see [`docs/ADAPTERS.md`](docs/ADAPTERS.md).

### Artifact Layout

By default, STEP stores trial artifacts under:

- `STEP_ARTIFACTS_ROOT/<trial_id>/payloads`
- `STEP_ARTIFACTS_ROOT/<trial_id>/results`
- `STEP_ARTIFACTS_ROOT/<trial_id>/ancillary`

You can override `payloads_dir`, `results_dir`, and `ancillary_dir` per trial at registration.

### Idempotency

Each slide run uses:

- `input_hash = sha256(slide_id, location, model_name, model_version)`
- `idempotency_key = model_version:slide_id:input_hash`

Mongo enforces a unique index on `(trial_id, jobs.idempotency_key)`.

### Active Trial Restore

STEP persists trial registration configs in MongoDB (`trial_configs` collection).

- Registering a trial stores/updates config and marks it active.
- Deleting a trial marks it inactive (soft-disable).
- On startup, `STEP_RESTORE_ACTIVE_TRIALS=true` reloads active trials.
- `STEP_RESTORE_DRY_RUN=true` logs what would be restored without starting schedulers.

## Architecture (High-Level)

- API layer (`step/api/main.py`) handles trial lifecycle and manual trigger endpoints.
- Runtime/scheduler layer (`step/runtime.py`) manages registered trials and recurring scan/ingest jobs.
- Orchestration layer (`step/services/orchestrator.py`) runs scan -> submit -> ingest flow with idempotency.
- Adapter layer (`step/adapters/...`) isolates LIS data access and compute backends (for example `mock`, `sql_lis_example`, `local`, `lsf`, `slurm`).
- Persistence layer (`step/repositories/mongo_repository.py`) stores runs, trial config state, and audit/recovery metadata.
  Failed results persist `error` details in both run and result records when provided by the worker contract.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

_OFFSET_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d+)\s*(s|m|h|d|w|mo|y)\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)


def shifted_utc_now(offset: str) -> datetime:
    """Return UTC now shifted by an offset, e.g. '-6mo', '+2d', '-12h'."""
    return datetime.utcnow() + parse_offset(offset)


def parse_offset(offset: str) -> timedelta:
    match = _OFFSET_PATTERN.match(offset)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(
            "Invalid STEP_NOW_OFFSET. Use format like '-6mo', '+14d', '-12h', or '0d'."
        )

    amount = int(match.group(1))
    unit = match.group(2).lower()

    if unit == "s":
        return timedelta(seconds=amount)
    if unit == "m":
        return timedelta(minutes=amount)
    if unit == "h":
        return timedelta(hours=amount)
    if unit == "d":
        return timedelta(days=amount)
    if unit == "w":
        return timedelta(weeks=amount)
    if unit == "mo":
        return timedelta(days=30 * amount)
    if unit == "y":
        return timedelta(days=365 * amount)

    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported unit in STEP_NOW_OFFSET: {unit}")


def parse_cleanup_window(window: str) -> timedelta | None:
    """Parse STEP_PAYLOAD_CLEANUP_WINDOW, allowing 'never' or non-negative offsets."""
    if window.strip().lower() == "never":
        return None

    try:
        delta = parse_offset(window)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            "Invalid STEP_PAYLOAD_CLEANUP_WINDOW. Use 'never' or format like '7d', '30d', or '12h'."
        ) from exc

    if delta.total_seconds() < 0:
        raise ValueError("STEP_PAYLOAD_CLEANUP_WINDOW must be non-negative or 'never'.")
    return delta


def parse_scan_window(window: str) -> timedelta:
    """Parse STEP_SCAN_WINDOW, requiring a non-negative offset."""
    try:
        delta = parse_offset(window)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            "Invalid STEP_SCAN_WINDOW. Use format like '1d', '12h', or '30m'."
        ) from exc

    if delta.total_seconds() < 0:
        raise ValueError("STEP_SCAN_WINDOW must be non-negative.")
    return delta

class TrialRegistry:
    def __init__(self, repository: MongoRepository, settings: Settings):
        self._repo = repository
        self._settings = settings
        self._trials: dict[str, SilentTrial] = {}
        self._lock = RLock()

    def register_trial(self, config: SilentTrialConfig) -> SilentTrial:
        with self._lock:
            if config.trial_id in self._trials:
                raise TrialAlreadyRegisteredError(f"Trial '{config.trial_id}' is already registered")

            trial = self._build_trial(config)
            trial.start()
            self._trials[config.trial_id] = trial
            self._repo.upsert_trial_config(asdict(config), active=True)
            return trial

    def unregister_trial(self, trial_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            trial = self._trials.pop(trial_id, None)
            if trial is None:
                raise KeyError(trial_id)
            trial.shutdown()
            self._repo.mark_trial_inactive(trial_id)

    def get(self, trial_id: str) -> SilentTrial:
        with self._lock:
            trial = self._trials.get(trial_id)
            if trial is None:
                raise KeyError(trial_id)
            return trial

    def list_trials(self) -> list[SilentTrialConfig]:
        with self._lock:
            return [trial.config for trial in self._trials.values()]

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            trials = list(self._trials.values())
            self._trials.clear()
        for trial in trials:
            trial.shutdown()

    def _build_trial(self, config: SilentTrialConfig) -> SilentTrial:
        trial_settings = Settings(
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            mongo_uri=self._settings.mongo_uri,

            payload_cleanup_window=config.payload_cleanup_window,
            lsf_queue=self._settings.lsf_queue,
            lsf_project=self._settings.lsf_project,
            lsf_config=self._settings.lsf_config,
            slurm_partition=self._settings.slurm_partition,
            slurm_account=self._settings.slurm_account,

            inference_entrypoint=self._settings.inference_entrypoint,
            lsf_dry_run=self._settings.lsf_dry_run,
            slurm_dry_run=self._settings.slurm_dry_run,
            model_name=config.model_name,
            model_version=config.model_version,
            now_offset=config.now_offset,
        )
        data_source = build_data_source(config.data_source)
        compute = build_compute_adapter(
            config.compute_adapter,
            trial_settings,
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            results_dir=config.results_dir,
            payloads_dir=config.payloads_dir,
            compute_config=config.compute_config,
        )
        ancillary = build_ancillary_adapter(
            config.ancillary_adapter,
            trial_settings,
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            ancillary_dir=config.ancillary_dir,
            ancillary_config=config.ancillary_config,
        )

        orchestrator = ScanOrchestrator(
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            repository=self._repo,
            data_source=data_source,
            compute=compute,
            ancillary=ancillary,
            payloads_dir=config.payloads_dir,
            model_name=config.model_name,
            model_version=config.model_version,
            now_fn=lambda: shifted_utc_now(config.now_offset),
            scan_window=config.scan_window,
            payload_cleanup_window=config.payload_cleanup_window,
        )
        scheduler = StepScheduler(
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            orchestrator=orchestrator,
            scan_cron=config.scan_cron,
            ingest_interval_minutes=config.ingest_interval_minutes,
            ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes=config.ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes,
        )
        return SilentTrial(
            trial_id=config.trial_id,
            repository=self._repo,
            orchestrator=orchestrator,
            scheduler=scheduler,
            config=config,
        )


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Container:
    settings: Settings
    repository: MongoRepository
    trials: TrialRegistry


def build_container() -> Container:
    settings = get_settings()
    repository = MongoRepository(settings.mongo_uri, settings.mongo_db_name)
    trials = TrialRegistry(repository=repository, settings=settings)
    if settings.restore_active_trials:
        restored = 0
        skipped = 0
        for row in repository.list_active_trial_configs():
            try:
                cfg = SilentTrialConfig(**row)
            except TypeError:
                logger.exception("Skipping persisted trial config due to schema mismatch: %s", row)
                skipped += 1
                continue
            if settings.restore_dry_run:
                logger.info("Dry-run restore: would restore active trial '%s'", cfg.trial_id)
                restored += 1
                continue
            try:
                trials.register_trial(cfg)
                restored += 1
            except (TrialAlreadyRegisteredError, ValueError):
                logger.exception("Failed to auto-restore trial '%s'", cfg.trial_id)
                skipped += 1
        logger.info(
            "Active trial restore complete. restored=%s skipped=%s dry_run=%s",
            restored,
            skipped,
            settings.restore_dry_run,
        )

    return Container(
        settings=settings,
        repository=repository,
        trials=trials,
    )

def backup(mongo_uri: str, db_name: str, out_dir: str) -> None:
    Path(out_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = ["mongodump", "--uri", mongo_uri, "--db", db_name, "--out", out_dir]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)


def restore(mongo_uri: str, db_name: str, backup_dir: str, drop: bool) -> None:
    archive_path = Path(backup_dir) / db_name
    cmd = ["mongorestore", "--uri", mongo_uri, "--db", db_name]
    if drop:
        cmd.append("--drop")
    cmd.append(str(archive_path))
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)


def main() -> None:

    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["backup", "restore"])

    parser.add_argument("--db", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--drop", action="store_true")

        backup(args.mongo_uri, args.db, args.path)
    else:

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


REQUIRED_RESULT_FIELDS = (
    "trial_id",
    "run_id",
    "case_id",
    "slide_id",
    "model_name",
    "model_version",
    "scores",
    "status",
)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="STEP worker contract enforcer")
    parser.add_argument("--entrypoint", required=True, help="Path to user inference entrypoint")
    parser.add_argument("--payload", required=True, help="Path to run payload JSON")
    parser.add_argument("--results-dir", required=True, help="Directory where result JSON is written")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    payload_path = Path(args.payload)
    results_dir = Path(args.results_dir)
    entrypoint_path = Path(args.entrypoint)

    try:
        payload = _load_payload(payload_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Invalid payload: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    run_id = str(payload["run_id"])
    results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result_path = results_dir / f"{run_id}.json"

    if not entrypoint_path.exists():
        _write_failed_result(payload, result_path, f"inference entrypoint not found: {entrypoint_path}")
        return 1

    started_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    cmd = [
        str(entrypoint_path),
        "--payload",
        str(payload_path),
        "--results-dir",
        str(results_dir),
    ]
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(cmd, check=False)
    except Exception as exc:
        _write_failed_result(payload, result_path, f"failed to start inference command: {exc}", started_at=started_at)
        return 1
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        _write_failed_result(
            payload,
            result_path,
            f"inference entrypoint exited with code {completed.returncode}",
            started_at=started_at,
        )
        return completed.returncode

    try:
        _validate_result(payload=payload, result_path=result_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        _write_failed_result(payload, result_path, f"invalid result contract: {exc}", started_at=started_at)
        return 1

    return 0


def _load_payload(payload_path: Path) -> dict:
    if not payload_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"payload not found: {payload_path}")
    payload = json.loads(payload_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    required_payload_fields = ("trial_id", "run_id", "case_id", "slide_id", "model_name", "model_version")
    missing = [field for field in required_payload_fields if field not in payload]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"payload missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
    return payload


def _validate_result(payload: dict, result_path: Path) -> None:
    if not result_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"expected result file missing: {result_path}")

    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    missing = [field for field in REQUIRED_RESULT_FIELDS if field not in result]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"result missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")

    if str(result["run_id"]) != str(payload["run_id"]):
        raise ValueError("result run_id does not match payload run_id")
    if str(result["trial_id"]) != str(payload["trial_id"]):
        raise ValueError("result trial_id does not match payload trial_id")
    if str(result["case_id"]) != str(payload["case_id"]):
        raise ValueError("result case_id does not match payload case_id")
    if str(result["slide_id"]) != str(payload["slide_id"]):
        raise ValueError("result slide_id does not match payload slide_id")
    if not isinstance(result["scores"], dict):
        raise ValueError("result scores must be a JSON object")


def _write_failed_result(payload: dict, result_path: Path, reason: str, started_at: str | None = None) -> None:
    now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    failed = {
        "trial_id": payload.get("trial_id"),
        "run_id": payload.get("run_id"),
        "case_id": payload.get("case_id"),
        "slide_id": payload.get("slide_id"),
        "model_name": payload.get("model_name"),
        "model_version": payload.get("model_version"),
        "scores": {},
        "status": "failed",
        "started_at": started_at,
        "finished_at": now,
        "metadata_snapshot": payload.get("metadata", {}),
        "logs_ref": None,
        "error": reason,
    }
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(failed, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from datetime import datetime

from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler
from apscheduler.triggers.cron import CronTrigger

from step.services.orchestrator import ScanOrchestrator


class StepScheduler:
    def __init__(
        self,
        trial_id: str,
        orchestrator: ScanOrchestrator,
        scan_cron: str,
        ingest_interval_minutes: int = 15,
        ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes: int = 1440,
    ):
        self._trial_id = trial_id
        self._orchestrator = orchestrator
        self._scheduler = BackgroundScheduler(timezone="America/New_York")
        self._scan_cron = scan_cron
        self._ingest_interval_minutes = ingest_interval_minutes
        self._ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes = ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._scheduler.add_job(
            self._orchestrator.run_daily_scan,
            trigger=CronTrigger.from_crontab(self._scan_cron),
            id=f"{self._trial_id}:daily_scan",
            replace_existing=True,
        )
        self._scheduler.add_job(
            self._orchestrator.ingest_results,
            trigger="interval",
            minutes=self._ingest_interval_minutes,
            id=f"{self._trial_id}:result_ingest",
            replace_existing=True,
        )
        self._scheduler.add_job(
            self._orchestrator.ingest_ancillary_data,
            trigger="interval",
            minutes=self._ancillary_ingest_interval_minutes,
            id=f"{self._trial_id}:ancillary_ingest",
            replace_existing=True,
        )
        self._scheduler.start()

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)

    def list_jobs(self) -> list[dict[str, str | None]]:
        out: list[dict[str, str | None]] = []
        for job in self._scheduler.get_jobs():
            next_run_time = job.next_run_time
            out.append(
                {
                    "id": job.id,
                    "name": job.name,
                    "trigger": str(job.trigger),
                    "next_run_time": _format_dt(next_run_time),
                }
            )
        return out


def _format_dt(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.isoformat()

        trial_ids = set(registered) | set(persisted)

        for trial_id in trial_ids:
            persisted_row = persisted.get(trial_id)
            is_registered = trial_id in registered

            if is_registered:

                "is_registered": is_registered,
                "config": registered.get(trial_id) or (persisted_row["config"] if persisted_row is not None else None),
            }

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from step.core.time_utils import parse_cleanup_window, parse_scan_window
from step.core.interfaces import AncillaryDataAdapter, ComputeAdapter, DataSourceAdapter
from step.domain.models import InferenceJob, JobStatus, PathologySlide, SlideStatus
from step.repositories.mongo_repository import MongoRepository


class ScanOrchestrator:
    def __init__(
        self,
        trial_id: str,
        repository: MongoRepository,
        data_source: DataSourceAdapter,
        compute: ComputeAdapter,
        ancillary: AncillaryDataAdapter,
        payloads_dir: str,
        model_name: str,
        model_version: str,
        now_fn: Callable[[], datetime] = datetime.utcnow,
        scan_window: str = "1d",
        payload_cleanup_window: str = "never",
    ):
        self._trial_id = trial_id
        self._repo = repository
        self._source = data_source
        self._compute = compute
        self._ancillary = ancillary
        self._payloads_dir = Path(payloads_dir)
        self._payloads_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._model_name = model_name
        self._model_version = model_version
        self._now_fn = now_fn
        self._scan_window = parse_scan_window(scan_window)
        self._payload_cleanup_window = parse_cleanup_window(payload_cleanup_window)

    def run_daily_scan(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:
        now = now or self._now_fn()
        window_start = now - self._scan_window

        cases = self._source.retrieve(window_start, now)
        submitted = 0
        skipped = 0

        for case in cases:
            self._repo.upsert_case(self._trial_id, case)
            for slide in case.slides:
                idem = self._idempotency_key(slide)
                if self._repo.job_exists(self._trial_id, idem):
                    skipped += 1
                    continue

                run_id = str(uuid4())
                payload_path = str(self._write_payload(run_id, case.case_id, slide))
                scheduler_job_id = self._compute.submit_slide_job(slide, run_id, payload_path)
                job = InferenceJob(
                    run_id=run_id,
                    case_id=case.case_id,
                    slide_id=slide.slide_id,
                    model_name=self._model_name,
                    model_version=self._model_version,
                    input_hash=self._input_hash(slide),
                    idempotency_key=idem,
                    scheduler_job_id=scheduler_job_id,
                    status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
                    created_at=now,
                    payload_path=payload_path,
                )
                self._repo.insert_job(self._trial_id, job)
                self._repo.append_audit(
                    self._trial_id,
                    "job_submitted",
                    {
                        "run_id": run_id,
                        "case_id": case.case_id,
                        "slide_id": slide.slide_id,
                        "scheduler_job_id": scheduler_job_id,
                    },
                )
                submitted += 1

        self._repo.append_audit(
            self._trial_id,
            "scan_completed",
            {
                "window_start": window_start.isoformat(),
                "window_end": now.isoformat(),
                "submitted": submitted,
                "skipped_existing": skipped,
            },
        )
        return {"submitted": submitted, "skipped": skipped, "cases": len(cases)}

    def ingest_results(self) -> int:
        results = self._compute.fetch_completed_results()
        for result in results:
            self._repo.save_result(self._trial_id, result)
            self._repo.update_job_status(
                trial_id=self._trial_id,
                run_id=result.run_id,
                status=result.status,
                started_at=result.started_at,
                finished_at=result.finished_at,
                logs_ref=result.logs_ref,
                error=result.error,
            )
            self._repo.append_audit(
                self._trial_id,
                "result_ingested",
                {
                    "run_id": result.run_id,
                    "case_id": result.case_id,
                    "slide_id": result.slide_id,
                    "status": result.status.value,
                    "error": result.error,
                },
            )
        self._cleanup_payloads()
        return len(results)

    def ingest_ancillary_data(self) -> int:
        ancillary_updates = self._ancillary.fetch_updates()
        for record in ancillary_updates:
            updated = self._repo.save_ancillary_data(self._trial_id, record)
            self._repo.append_audit(
                self._trial_id,
                "ancillary_data_ingested",
                {
                    "run_id": record.run_id,
                    "source": record.source,
                    "linked_to_result": updated,
                },
            )
        return len(ancillary_updates)

    def retry_failed_run(self, run_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        job = self._repo.get_job(self._trial_id, run_id)
        if job is None:
            raise KeyError(run_id)
        if job.get("status") != JobStatus.FAILED.value:
            raise ValueError(f"Run '{run_id}' is not failed; current status is '{job.get('status')}'.")

        retry_run_id = str(uuid4())
        case_id = str(job["case_id"])
        slide_id = str(job["slide_id"])
        model_name = str(job["model_name"])
        model_version = str(job["model_version"])
        input_hash = str(job["input_hash"])
        source_idempotency_key = str(job["idempotency_key"])
        retry_idempotency_key = f"{source_idempotency_key}:retry:{retry_run_id}"

        payload_path = str(self._payloads_dir / f"{retry_run_id}.json")
        self._write_retry_payload(
            payload_path=Path(payload_path),
            run_id=retry_run_id,
            case_id=case_id,
            slide_id=slide_id,
            model_name=model_name,
            model_version=model_version,
        )

        slide = PathologySlide(
            slide_id=slide_id,
            case_id=case_id,
            status=SlideStatus.DIGITIZED,
        )
        scheduler_job_id = self._compute.submit_slide_job(slide, retry_run_id, payload_path)
        retry_job = InferenceJob(
            run_id=retry_run_id,
            case_id=case_id,
            slide_id=slide_id,
            model_name=model_name,
            model_version=model_version,
            input_hash=input_hash,
            idempotency_key=retry_idempotency_key,
            scheduler_job_id=scheduler_job_id,
            status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
            created_at=self._now_fn(),
            payload_path=payload_path,
        )
        self._repo.insert_job(self._trial_id, retry_job)
        self._repo.append_audit(
            self._trial_id,
            "job_retried",
            {
                "source_run_id": run_id,
                "retry_run_id": retry_run_id,
                "case_id": case_id,
                "slide_id": slide_id,
                "scheduler_job_id": scheduler_job_id,
            },
        )
        return {
            "source_run_id": run_id,
            "retry_run_id": retry_run_id,
            "scheduler_job_id": scheduler_job_id or "",
        }

    def _write_payload(self, run_id: str, case_id: str, slide: PathologySlide) -> Path:
        payload_path = self._payloads_dir / f"{run_id}.json"
        payload = {
            "trial_id": self._trial_id,
            "run_id": run_id,
            "case_id": case_id,
            "slide_id": slide.slide_id,
            "slide_location": slide.location,
            "metadata": slide.metadata,
            "model_name": self._model_name,
            "model_version": self._model_version,
            "created_at": self._now_fn().isoformat(),
        }
        payload_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        return payload_path

    def _input_hash(self, slide: PathologySlide) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(
            f"{slide.slide_id}:{slide.location}:{self._model_name}:{self._model_version}".encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

    def _idempotency_key(self, slide: PathologySlide) -> str:
        return f"{self._model_version}:{slide.slide_id}:{self._input_hash(slide)}"

    def _cleanup_payloads(self) -> None:
        if self._payload_cleanup_window is None:
            return

        now = self._now_fn()
        cutoff = now - self._payload_cleanup_window
        candidates = self._repo.list_payload_cleanup_candidates(self._trial_id, created_before=cutoff)

        deleted = 0
        missing = 0
        errors = 0
        cleared_run_ids: list[str] = []

        for candidate in candidates:
            run_id = candidate["run_id"]
            payload_path = Path(candidate["payload_path"])
            try:
                existed_before = payload_path.exists()
                payload_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                if payload_path.exists():
                    errors += 1
                    continue
                if existed_before:
                    deleted += 1
                else:
                    missing += 1
                cleared_run_ids.append(run_id)
            except OSError:
                errors += 1

        self._repo.clear_job_payload_paths(self._trial_id, cleared_run_ids)
        if candidates:
            self._repo.append_audit(
                self._trial_id,
                "payload_cleanup_completed",
                {
                    "window_seconds": int(self._payload_cleanup_window.total_seconds()),
                    "cutoff": cutoff.isoformat(),
                    "candidates": len(candidates),
                    "deleted": deleted,
                    "missing": missing,
                    "errors": errors,
                },
            )

    def _write_retry_payload(
        self,
        payload_path: Path,
        run_id: str,
        case_id: str,
        slide_id: str,
        model_name: str,
        model_version: str,
    ) -> None:
        payload = {
            "trial_id": self._trial_id,
            "run_id": run_id,
            "case_id": case_id,
            "slide_id": slide_id,
            "slide_location": None,
            "metadata": {},
            "model_name": model_name,
            "model_version": model_version,
            "created_at": self._now_fn().isoformat(),
        }
        payload_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from step.domain.models import AncillaryDataRecord

REQUIRED_ANCILLARY_FIELDS = (
    "trial_id",
    "run_id",
    "ancillary_data",
)


def load_ancillary_record(path: Path, expected_trial_id: str) -> AncillaryDataRecord:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    missing = [field for field in REQUIRED_ANCILLARY_FIELDS if field not in payload]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"ancillary payload missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")

    trial_id = str(payload["trial_id"])
    if trial_id != expected_trial_id:
        raise ValueError(
            f"ancillary payload trial_id '{trial_id}' does not match expected trial_id '{expected_trial_id}'"
        )

    ancillary_data = payload["ancillary_data"]
    if not isinstance(ancillary_data, dict):
        raise ValueError("ancillary_data must be a JSON object")

    observed_at = _parse_optional_datetime(payload.get("observed_at"))
    source = _parse_optional_string(payload.get("source"))

    return AncillaryDataRecord(
        trial_id=trial_id,
        run_id=str(payload["run_id"]),
        ancillary_data=ancillary_data,
        observed_at=observed_at,
        source=source,
    )


def _parse_optional_datetime(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("observed_at must be an ISO datetime string when provided")
    normalized = value.strip()
    if not normalized:
        return None
    return datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)


def _parse_optional_string(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("source must be a string when provided")
    normalized = value.strip()
    return normalized or None

        trial_id: str,

        case_id: str | None = None,
        slide_id: str | None = None,
        date_from: datetime | None = None,
        date_to: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        size = max(1, min(int(page_size), 200))
        base_query: dict[str, Any] = {"trial_id": trial_id}
        if case_id:
            base_query["case_id"] = case_id
        if slide_id:
            base_query["slide_id"] = slide_id
        if date_from is not None or date_to is not None:
            created_filter: dict[str, Any] = {}
            if date_from is not None:
                created_filter["$gte"] = date_from
            if date_to is not None:
                created_filter["$lt"] = date_to
            base_query["created_at"] = created_filter

        query: dict[str, Any] = dict(base_query)
        if cursor_created_at is not None:
            cursor_filter: dict[str, Any]
            if cursor_run_id:
                cursor_filter = {
                    "$or": [
                        {"created_at": {"$lt": cursor_created_at}},
                        {"created_at": cursor_created_at, "run_id": {"$lt": cursor_run_id}},
                    ]
                }
            else:
                cursor_filter = {"created_at": {"$lt": cursor_created_at}}

            query = {"$and": [dict(base_query), cursor_filter]}

        rows = list(
            self._jobs.find(query, {"_id": 0})
            .sort([("created_at", -1), ("run_id", -1)])
            .limit(size + 1)
        )

        has_more = len(rows) > size
        page_rows = rows[:size]
        next_cursor: dict[str, str] | None = None
        if has_more and page_rows:
            last = page_rows[-1]
            created_at = last.get("created_at")
            run_id = last.get("run_id")
            if isinstance(created_at, datetime) and isinstance(run_id, str):
                next_cursor = {"created_at": created_at.isoformat(), "run_id": run_id}

        total_runs = self._jobs.count_documents(base_query)
        return {"runs": page_rows, "next_cursor": next_cursor, "total_runs": total_runs}

    def get_cases(self, trial_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        cursor = self._cases.find({"trial_id": trial_id}, {"_id": 0}).sort("case_id", 1)
        return list(cursor)

    def get_cases_page(
        self,
        trial_id: str,
        page_size: int = 50,
        cursor_case_id: str | None = None,
        case_id_query: str | None = None,
        slide_id_query: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        size = max(1, min(int(page_size), 200))
        base_query: dict[str, Any] = {"trial_id": trial_id}

        if case_id_query:
            base_query["case_id"] = {"$regex": re.escape(case_id_query), "$options": "i"}
        if slide_id_query:
            base_query["slides.slide_id"] = {"$regex": re.escape(slide_id_query), "$options": "i"}

        query: dict[str, Any] = dict(base_query)
        if cursor_case_id:
            query = {"$and": [dict(base_query), {"case_id": {"$gt": cursor_case_id}}]}

        rows = list(
            self._cases.find(query, {"_id": 0})
            .sort([("case_id", 1)])
            .limit(size + 1)
        )

        has_more = len(rows) > size
        page_rows = rows[:size]
        next_cursor: dict[str, str] | None = None
        if has_more and page_rows:
            last_case_id = page_rows[-1].get("case_id")
            if isinstance(last_case_id, str):
                next_cursor = {"case_id": last_case_id}

        case_ids = [row.get("case_id") for row in page_rows if isinstance(row.get("case_id"), str)]
        run_counts = self.get_run_counts_by_case(trial_id=trial_id, case_ids=case_ids)
        for row in page_rows:
            case_id = row.get("case_id")
            slides = row.get("slides", [])
            row["slide_count"] = len(slides) if isinstance(slides, list) else 0
            row["run_count"] = run_counts.get(case_id, 0) if isinstance(case_id, str) else 0

        total_cases = self._cases.count_documents(base_query)
        return {"cases": page_rows, "next_cursor": next_cursor, "total_cases": total_cases}

    def get_run_counts_by_case(self, trial_id: str, case_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, int]:
        if not case_ids:
            return {}
        pipeline = [
            {"$match": {"trial_id": trial_id, "case_id": {"$in": case_ids}}},
            {"$group": {"_id": "$case_id", "count": {"$sum": 1}}},
        ]
        rows = list(self._jobs.aggregate(pipeline))
        return {str(row["_id"]): int(row.get("count", 0)) for row in rows if row.get("_id") is not None}

    def get_results(self, trial_id: str, limit: int = 200) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        cursor = self._results.find({"trial_id": trial_id}, {"_id": 0}).sort("created_at", -1).limit(limit)
        return list(cursor)

    def get_results_by_case(self, trial_id: str, limit: int = 200) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        rows = self.get_results(trial_id=trial_id, limit=limit)
        grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        for row in rows:
            case_id = row.get("case_id") or "unknown"
            grouped.setdefault(case_id, []).append(row)

        entries = [{"case_id": case_id, "results": items} for case_id, items in grouped.items()]
        entries.sort(key=lambda item: item["case_id"])
        return entries

    def get_results_by_slide(self, trial_id: str, slide_id: str, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        cursor = (
            self._results.find({"trial_id": trial_id, "slide_id": slide_id}, {"_id": 0})
            .sort("created_at", -1)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return list(cursor)

    def get_latest_result_by_slide(self, trial_id: str, slide_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        rows = self.get_results_by_slide(trial_id=trial_id, slide_id=slide_id, limit=1)
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def get_trial_counts(self, trial_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:
        return {
            "cases": self._cases.count_documents({"trial_id": trial_id}),
            "runs": self._jobs.count_documents({"trial_id": trial_id}),
            "results": self._results.count_documents({"trial_id": trial_id}),
            "slides": self._count_slides(trial_id),
        }

    def _count_slides(self, trial_id: str) -> int:
        pipeline = [
            {"$match": {"trial_id": trial_id}},
            {"$project": {"slide_count": {"$size": {"$ifNull": ["$slides", []]}}}},
            {"$group": {"_id": None, "total": {"$sum": "$slide_count"}}},
        ]
        rows = list(self._cases.aggregate(pipeline))
        if not rows:
            return 0
        return int(rows[0].get("total", 0))

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._client.close()

        Path(self._cfg.payloads_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        )

        if "-P" not in custom_args and self._cfg.project:

                "--entrypoint",

            ]
        )
        cmd.extend(
            [
                "--payload",
                payload_path,
                "--results-dir",
                self._cfg.results_dir,
            ]

                payload = json.load(f)

            if payload.get("trial_id") != self._cfg.trial_id:
                continue

            results.append(
                InferenceResult(
                    run_id=payload["run_id"],
                    case_id=payload["case_id"],
                    slide_id=payload["slide_id"],
                    model_name=payload["model_name"],
                    model_version=payload["model_version"],

                    metadata_snapshot=payload.get("metadata_snapshot", {}),
                    logs_ref=payload.get("logs_ref"),

                )
            )
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

        return results


def _dt(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)


def _load_bsub_config(config_path: str) -> list[str]:
    if not config_path:
        return []

    path = Path(config_path)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"STEP_LSF_CONFIG file not found: {config_path}")

    args: list[str] = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("#BSUB"):
            stripped = stripped[len("#BSUB") :].strip()
        elif stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue

        if not stripped:
            continue

        tokens = shlex.split(stripped, posix=True)
        if tokens and tokens[0] == "bsub":
            tokens = tokens[1:]
        args.extend(tokens)
    return args


def _render_bsub_args(args: list[str], run_id: str, results_dir: str, payload_path: str) -> list[str]:
    job_name = f"STEP_{run_id}"
    rendered: list[str] = []
    for arg in args:
        rendered.append(
            arg.replace("{run_id}", run_id)
            .replace("{job_name}", job_name)
            .replace("{results_dir}", results_dir)
            .replace("{payload_path}", payload_path)
        )
    return rendered


def _read_optional_str(cfg: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> str | None:
    value = cfg.get(key)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"compute_config.{key} must be a string")
    normalized = value.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _read_optional_bool(cfg: dict[str, Any], key: str, *, default: bool) -> bool:
    value = cfg.get(key)
    if value is None:
        return default
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError(f"compute_config.{key} must be a boolean")
    return value


def _resolve_and_validate_path(field_name: str, value: str) -> str:
    normalized = value.strip()
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} cannot be empty")

    forbidden_chars = set(";|&`$><\n\r")
    if any(char in forbidden_chars for char in normalized):
        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} contains forbidden shell characters")

    candidate = Path(normalized).expanduser()
    if not candidate.is_absolute():
        candidate = (Path.cwd() / candidate).resolve(strict=False)
    else:
        candidate = candidate.resolve(strict=False)

    allowed_root = Path.cwd().resolve(strict=False)
    if not candidate.is_relative_to(allowed_root):
        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} must be under allowed root: {allowed_root}")

    return str(candidate)
